ActionSpec.description: Parsed and validated so the spec is complete; nothing executes it before Phase 3.
ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

Appearance.description:
Opt-in backdrop (invariant 9 amendment, 2026-09-27): an image of the admin's choosing
behind the boards, dimmed and optionally blurred, with translucent cards. Surfaces
only; ``--status-*`` never changes. Off unless ``background`` names a file.
Appearance.title: Appearance

AuthQuery.description:
A secret sent as a query parameter, for APIs that accept nothing else (SABnzbd's
``apikey``; Jellyfin's ``ApiKey``, the one form not behind its legacy switch). Added
2026-09-25; a new auth type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a). A URL is where secrets
leak, so the value is masked in every log line and provider error (hud.config.redact)
— but the target app's own access log is beyond HUD's reach: point base_url at the
container, not through a reverse proxy that logs query strings.
AuthQuery.title: AuthQuery

AuthSettings.description: Which identity backends run, in precedence order (PLAN.md §10.1).
AuthSettings.title: AuthSettings

BarsWidget.description:
One metric across many resources: per-core CPU, busiest containers. Added
2026-09-26; a new widget type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a).
BarsWidget.title: BarsWidget

ChartSource.description:
PLAN §8.2: named ``series`` over a ``range``, read from the ``tier`` that suits it.
Also (added 2026-09-28) one series per resource a selection matches — ``select`` +
``metric`` — the busiest ``limit`` of them by their latest value.
ChartSource.title: ChartSource

ChartWidget.description:
A metric over time from HUD's own history — invariant 10: never from Prometheus
alone. Series are neutral (invariant 9): told apart by weight, dash and label, never
by hue; only threshold lines carry a status colour. Added 2026-09-28, dashboard/v1-
compatible (§11.3a).
ChartWidget.title: ChartWidget

ForwardAuthSettings.description: Trusted-proxy header auth. Header names are config so any forward-auth provider fits.
ForwardAuthSettings.title: ForwardAuthSettings

Grid.description: 1-based cell position on the ``lg`` grid; smaller breakpoints reflow in the SPA.
Grid.title: Grid

HeaderSettings.description:
The strip above every board (§12, header): greeting, clock, search, weather, stats.

Instance-wide and admin-authored: every signed-in user sees what is named here, whatever
their boards show — so name only what everyone may see.
HeaderSettings.title: HeaderSettings

HeatmapWidget.description:
One metric by weekday and hour of day, in settings.timezone — when things get
used. Intensity is neutral, never a status colour. Added 2026-09-28.
HeatmapWidget.title: HeatmapWidget

HeroStat.description:
One reading in a hero strip: a metric of any resource, labelled, judged by its own
thresholds. A percentage draws as a small gauge; anything else as a number.
HeroStat.title: HeroStat

IncidentsWidget.description:
What went down, when, and for how long, from availability history. Added
2026-09-27; a new widget type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a).
IncidentsWidget.title: IncidentsWidget

ProviderSpec.description:
Either tier, one envelope.

* Tier 1 (declarative): ``transport`` + ``resources[]``.
* Tier 2 (plugin): ``plugin`` (its registered name) + ``config`` (validated by the
  plugin's own config model at build time; ``${secret:}`` and ``${VAR}`` apply).
ProviderSpec.title: ProviderSpec

RbacSpec.description:
``defaults.unmatched_group`` need not be listed under ``groups``: an unlisted group
grants nothing, which is the safe reading.
RbacSpec.title: RbacSpec

Requirement.description: One placeholder the user must supply before a template works.
Requirement.title: Requirement

Retention.description: Retention per tier (PLAN.md §6.2). Stored as the user wrote them; parsed on demand.
Retention.title: Retention

StatusWidget.description:
A status page's headline over a selection: "All systems operational", or what is
not. Added 2026-09-27; a new widget type is dashboard/v1-compatible (§11.3a).
StatusWidget.title: StatusWidget

TemplateInfo.description:
Display metadata a bundled template carries (PLAN.md §8.5.1). Harmless on a
hand-written provider; the wizard catalog reads it in Phase 3.
TemplateInfo.title: TemplateInfo

UnsupportedWidget.description: Any type this build cannot render. Kept verbatim so write-back preserves it.
UnsupportedWidget.title: UnsupportedWidget

UptimeSource.description: One resource (``resource:``, as PLAN §8 shows it) or a selection of them.
UptimeSource.title: UptimeSource

UptimeWidget.description:
Availability history as a strip of cells per resource, and its SLA % (PLAN §8,
§6.3). Implemented 2026-09-27 (Phase 2 slice 1); the type was reserved from v1.
UptimeWidget.title: UptimeWidget

description: One schema per document kind. Provider and Board are frozen at hud/v1; Settings and RBAC may still gain optional keys.
title: HUD configuration (hud/v1)
